sources.finding: Final CLE 12, NYJ 17. Howard 35/68 offensive snaps, Jones 33/68; Watson and Smith handled all offensive snaps. Final participants, inactive/DNP lists and printed injury/return sequences reviewed. Regulation ended without overtime.
Both clubs final inactive inventories; Tim Patrick active, Jaden Keller elevated.
NYJ OUT: Hall, Mauigoa, Mitchell, Parham. CLE OUT: Davis, Gabriel, Graham, Hall, Jenkins, Ryan, Wallace. Remaining listed questionable players participated.
Dated Week 5 roles: Huntington behind Graham, Bond behind Concepcion; Barber first RG, injured Teven Jenkins second. Specialists and return depth reviewed.
Seven confirmed OUT; Davis and Gabriel remain in return windows; Teven Jenkins absent five consecutive games.
Kamara and Chris Williams elevated for interior injuries. Postgame: Judkins ankle and Schwesinger injuries; no exact lost-duty interval supplied.
Reserve chronology reviewed. Raheim Sanders IR starts October 13, after this game. Kendrick Green and Tyreak Sapp released before kickoff. Nathaniel Watson was practice-squad injured.
Current reserve cross-check only; historical dates come from dated transactions. Includes Mathis, Sampson, Alex Wright, Royer and Owusu-Koramoah.
Sampson placed on IR September 15; McLaughlin promoted in the same transaction.
Return window opened October 14, after Week 5.
Barber retained starting RG job on merit after Week 1; Teven Jenkins is not automatically a current starter vacancy.
Alex Wright placed on IR August 23; Derek Barnett signed concurrently.
Owusu-Koramoah on reserve/PUP from May 8 with the neck injury sustained in 2024.
July projected linebacker core Schwesinger/Williams; Owusu-Koramoah absent from listed available room.
Mutable depth cross-check with final participation and preserved Week 5 estimates; not represented as an archived October 11 page.
August reserve placements, September Cooper/Onyemata/McCrary-Ball/Smith IR, and October McGregor IR/Patrick activation reviewed.
Current reserve cross-check only; dated transactions establish historical status. Mykal Walker absent from current roster; exact post-August disposition still needs confirmation.
Onyemata, McCrary-Ball and Arian Smith moved to IR September 22; Heflin and McClain promoted.
Club identifies Heflin addition for Onyemata absence and McClain following Smith injury.
Cooper ankle IR from September 19; established opening-series regular-season participation.
Cooper return window opened October 14, after this game.
Patrick activated October 10; Pritchett waived before kickoff.
